## Summary / 更新内容

Describe what changed and why. / 简述本次变更。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Tests and CI pass / 测试与 CI 已通过
- [ ] No unverified claims or generated inference metrics / 未使用未经验证的性能或推理数据
- [ ] If GUI changed, update `docs/images/ui-overview.svg`, `docs/images/ui-result-demo.svg`, and README previews / 若修改界面，已同步更新原型图片和 README
- [ ] UI demo values are clearly identified as illustrative / 原型中的示例数值明确标注为演示数据
